crafts.name: Plant Pot
instructions: Remove stickers from the container by scraping them off or using hot water
Clean and dry the container to remove any residue
Paint and decorate the outer surface of the container if desired
Place small pebbles at the bottom of the container for drainage
Pour a thick layer of soil over the pebbles
Plant seeds into the soil or place a small plant into the soil
crafts.sustainability_note: The plastic container is durable, lightweight, and easy to handle, making it suitable for reuse as a plant pot.
environmental_benefits: Prevents harmful chemicals from leaking into the environment
Encourages gardening, which benefits the environment
Creates a small indoor air-purifying plant space
